decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 2015, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification; the commercial uses hereby approved, shall not be changed to any other use, without further approval in writing from the Local Planning Authority, with the exception of Unit 9, which may be used for either A1 or B1 uses and Unit 13, which may be used for either D1 (Health Clinic) or B1 and Unit 5, which may be used for A3/A4/B1 use.
description: Non material amendment to allow Unit 5 to be changed to A3/A4/B1 use of planning permission 00657/P/P16 dated 27/10/2011 for the erection of a mixed use development including 308 new dwellings 3,693sq.m of mixed use commercial space (A1-A4, B1, D1-D2 uses), basement car and cycle parking, hard and soft landscaping use of Arches 4 and 5 of Kew Bridge for river related and installation of a pontoon.
